sole_change.validator: upstream resolution and offline object materialization
sole_change.v1_3_defect: The sole upstream network command used ls-remote, resolving main without materializing the newly resolved object required by the network-forbidden production build.
sole_change.v1_4_correction: The same second and final preflight network operation is one no-retry atomic fetch into a preregistered absent bare SHA-1 object store and explicit namespaced destination ref. Its porcelain output, commit, root tree, FormalConjectures subtree, and isolation/fsck audit are frozen for offline replay.
sole_change.failure_policy: any preexisting store, command/path drift, retry, extra network call, missing object, ref/tree/subtree mismatch, shallow/promisor/alternate/remote state, or chronology mismatch fails closed

versioned_execution_plumbing.description: Names, schemas, domain separators, workflows, and authoritative default paths are versioned from v1.3 to v1.4 without changing the scientific design.
versioned_execution_plumbing.provenance_policy_default: The v1.4 contamination prototype defaults to the v1.4 authoritative protocol policy; the production registry still injects and content-addresses those exact frozen policy bytes.
versioned_execution_plumbing.session_snapshot_isolation: After P0T, one complete sync is copied to the preregistered immutable ai-chats and retained-session snapshot paths so ongoing sync jobs cannot drift S0 during the sole registry build.
